trigger_signals: Another AI agent needs scoped, expiring access to a local browser session and someone must set up the pairing
Someone asks what a pairing would expose, for how long and how to revoke it
guidance: Preview the session-loss consequence before anything runs: pairing can relaunch the browser daemon, and a relaunch kills open tabs, cookies and logged-in sessions. Require explicit consent for a relaunch as a one-way action, and offer a pairing path that does not relaunch when one exists.

procedure_insert.text: State whether the pairing relaunches the browser daemon and what open tabs, cookies and sessions would be lost; require explicit consent for that loss.

trigger_signals: An existing browser-agent pairing must be checked for health, expiry and whether its scope matches what was approved
Someone asks why a paired agent cannot act, or whether a pairing is broader than intended
guidance: Diagnosis table: 'tab not owned by your agent' means the agent acted on a tab it did not create and must open its own tab; 'domain not allowed' means the token restricts domains and the pairing needs re-provisioning with the needed origin; an expired token needs renewal through the provisioning Skill.
After the remote agent is told to connect, confirm the connection from the browser status output and report which agent and scope appear.
